commands.command: set -eu; printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; cat /etc/os-release | sed -n '1,3p'; id; command -v dnf || true; rpm -q nfs-utils 2>/dev/null || true; getent passwd dataops || true; getent group dataops || true; systemctl is-active remote-fs.target 2>/dev/null || true; findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /mnt/shared 2>/dev/null || true; grep -F '/mnt/shared' /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null || true
